steps.what: Identify the necessary supplies, equipment or services from current operations
Find current catalogue items, service terms and requisition references
Choose the requisition scope, quantity and required delivery timing
Write the requisition with the chosen supplies, equipment or service details
Check and submit the final requisition to purchasing

tasks.design: Use the current catalogue view and reusable requisition fields in {PROCUREMENT}. The supervisor determines need and scope, writes variable details and checks the actual internal submission; this is not a supplier order or automatic replenishment commitment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catalogue navigation and retyping stable purchasing references add requisition effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved catalogue views and requisition defaults can reuse existing references.
tasks.still_hard: Service scope, substitutions and urgency require operational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor distinguishes genuine need from a convenient repeat order.
tasks.altitude: Shorten requisition preparation while retaining need and scope decisions.

reach.task: Source the requested item or service
reach.learn: Which requisitions need more precise operational scope

evidence.claim: Native catalogue views and requisition defaults can remove repeated clerical entry; their local benefit is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's internal requisition, including its actual submission. Supplier commitment and purchasing approval are later existing processes and receive no saving here.

The supervisor produces the requirement from observation in s1 and quantity/timing in s3. Purchasing maintains catalogue terms and finance maintains cost-centre references through existing duties. Selecting and checking their current versions is counted in s2; missing data return to manual preparation in s4.

Native catalogue filtering removes three of15 search hours. Reusable requisition references remove14 of35 copying hours while retaining21 hours for variable specifications, checks and ordinary draft saves without a gate.
No par-level flag, automatic stock calculation, alert or supplier send is assumed.
unknowns: How often requisitions reuse stable fields
Whether current forms already apply the same defaults
research_questions: Which fields can be safely reused without carrying obsolete quantities or service scope?

already_counted.description: Current-reference checking and actual requisition writing remain in s2 and s4.

incremental.description: Supervisor checks saved requisition defaults after catalogue changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact item/service scope, quantities, dates, cost centre, requisition version and purchasing destination checked before actual submission; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R83, gross17 less upkeep1 gives net16. Low3 retains all15 search hours and31 requisition-writing hours when most requests are bespoke services, plus50 need/scope/submission hours: R96, net3. High11 retains13 search and25 writing hours for partly repeatable requests, plus50 other hours: R88, net11. Central retains12 search and21 writing hours with compatible defaults.

tasks.short: Direct and coordinate passenger attendant activities

steps.what: Observe passenger service needs and current worker activities
Check current attendant duties and operating references
Choose changes to attendant activities for the current service situation
Update the existing crew duty sheet with the chosen changes
Check and communicate the actual duty changes to attendants
Coach attendants and resolve emerging service coordination problems

tasks.design: Use a native crew-duty view in {OPS_SYSTEM} to find current assignments and edit the actual duty sheet. The supervisor observes, decides, communicates and coaches personally; no new record of routine service conversations is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current duty sheet and re-entering stable shift context can add small delays.
tasks.enabler_now: A saved current-shift view and native form defaults can remove those small clerical operations.
tasks.still_hard: Passenger needs and worker coordination evolve in real time.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor notices service pressure and helps the crew respond together.
tasks.altitude: Keep direct service supervision central with slightly easier duty-sheet access.

reach.learn: Which assignments are routinely changed during service

evidence.claim: A saved duty view may reduce small navigation and repeated-context costs; no local saving or automatic coordination capability is established.

assumptions: The existing crew duty sheet is read by attendants or the incoming supervisor. If the operation keeps no such sheet, this design does not create one and its writing benefit disappears.

The crew planner produces the initial sheet through existing work. The supervisor checks it in s2, observes new needs in s1 and produces changed-duty fields in s4; capture is counted. Missing context requires the current manual check.
The current-shift view removes one of10 reference hours. Form defaults remove0.5 of five update hours; actual duty writing, ordinary saves and all interpersonal coordination remain.
Internal colleague directions use internal authority. The gate checks the communicated duty version, not an ordinary same-system author save.
unknowns: Whether a crew duty sheet is updated during service today
research_questions: Does a current-shift view remove any actual navigation beyond the sheet already in use?

already_counted.description: Duty reference checks and real updates remain in s2 and s4.

incremental.description: Supervisor maintains the saved current-shift filter.

approvals.approved_version: Actual duty changes, affected attendants and timing checked immediately before communication; changed conditions invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R98.5, gross1.5 less upkeep0.25 gives net1.25. Low0 retains existing verbal coordination with no adopted duty-sheet configuration where no sheet exists. High0.75 retains9.5 reference hours and4.5 update hours plus85 observation/decision/communication/coaching hours: R99, less0.25 upkeep. Central retains nine reference hours when current-shift navigation can actually be removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recruit and hire passenger service staff

steps.what: Write the vacancy description to recruit staff members
Check and publish the final vacancy to the recruitment channel
Review applications and arrange the candidate interviews
outputs: reviewed applications and proposed interview times

steps.what: Conduct interviews and discuss candidate experience and role expectations
inputs: reviewed applications and proposed interview times

steps.what: Write interview evidence in the existing candidate evaluation form
Choose whom to hire and the permitted employment terms
Draft the employment offer using the chosen terms
Check and send the final employment offer to the candidate
Enter the accepted hiring details in the employee intake record

tasks.design: Reuse vacancy, evaluation and offer templates in {ATS}, and native application views and employee-intake defaults in {HCM}. The supervisor owns interviews, hiring decisions and terms and checks each external publication or offer sent through {EMAIL}; post-acceptance intake remains a separate phase.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recruitment documents and candidate records can repeat standard headings and unchanged details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native recruitment templates can remove that clerical repetition without ranking applicants.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing people, choosing terms and securing acceptance require judgement and dialogue.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor evaluates relevant experience and explains real job expectations.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated recruitment writing while preserving selection responsibility.

reach.learn: Which accepted hiring fields need clarification

evidence.claim: Native recruitment templates and intake defaults can remove standard clerical setup; no local saving or automated selection capability is established.

assumptions: The baseline includes actual vacancy, evaluation, offer and accepted-hire records used in recruitment and HR. No additional assessment report or author approval stage is added.

The supervisor produces role requirements in s1, candidate evidence in s4/s5 and selected terms in s6. Candidates produce applications and acceptance, and HR maintains permitted terms and templates in existing work. Their applicability and completeness are checked in the retained writing steps; missing fields are entered manually.

Vacancy reuse removes4.5 of15 drafting hours, application navigation removes1.5 of15 review/preparation hours, form headings remove two of10 evidence-writing hours, offer clauses remove2.5 of10 drafting hours and intake defaults remove one of five entry hours. Judgement, variable evidence, checking and ordinary saves remain.

s3 prepares proposed interview times only. Candidate invitation sending must be separately priced if performed by this supervisor; this scenario uses the recruiting administrator's existing invitation process and claims no saving from it. No new invitation routine is implied.
Hiring remains within existing delegated authority. No automatic selection, performance scoring, contract signature or payroll activation is proposed.
unknowns: Who currently publishes vacancies and sends invitations
Whether hiring templates already cover these stable sections
research_questions: Which recruitment documents require substantive rewriting despite an available template?

already_counted.description: Vacancy, application, evaluation, offer and intake preparation remain in s1, s3, s5, s7 and s9.

incremental.description: Supervisor checks template applicability after role or employment-term changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact vacancy wording, role, requirements, terms and publication channel checked before publication; edits invalidate the check.
Actual candidate question or statement checked for relevance and accuracy before speaking; changed questions require a fresh check.
Exact candidate, role, employment terms, offer document version and recipient checked immediately before sending; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R88.5, gross11.5 less upkeep1.5 gives net10. Low0 retains all current work if existing recruitment templates already remove these clerical operations and no change is adopted. High7 retains12 vacancy,14 application, eight evaluation, eight offer and4.5 intake hours, plus45 publication/interview/decision/send hours: R91.5, less1.5 upkeep. Central retains10.5,13.5, eight,7.5 and four clerical hours respectively; differing template compatibility drives the bound.

role.altitude: Keep passenger-service coordination and hiring decisions personal while reducing specific clerical work.
reach: Crew planners maintaining usable duty sheets
role.ambitious_version: A passenger-attendant supervisor who can direct the crew and recruit effectively without repeatedly rebuilding standard operational documents.
